adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for collective team event types, explicitly appends other hosts’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` in `handleNewBooking.ts`). However, when persisting the booking, it still only connects the first destination calendar (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), so the booking record can only retain one destination calendar. Later codepaths shown in the diff rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) and wrap it into a single-element array (or `[]`), e.g. confirm/payment/editLocation/requestReschedule/cancel/cron, so they cannot reconstruct the full multi-host destination list from the booking.
